## Context / Problem
Nine ADRs carry operator procedure alongside their decision. Existing runbooks (`git ls-tree origin/main -- infra/runbooks`): alarm-window-tuning, bedrock-access, bedrock-ci-oidc, g2p-ci-credentials, gate-scratch-mount, gerrit-auth-hardening, gerrit-data-volume-reclaim, gerrit-host-wedged-ssm-lost, gerrit-outbound-mail, gerrit-upgrade, github-mirror-lock, main-red-post-merge, mcp-client-pats, mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip, nginx-edge-render, provision-restore, review-bot-ops, ssm-secret-write-only, sso-auth-host, two-vote-gate-rollback. Most procedures already exist there in fuller form; the ADR copies are the drift.

## Approach
| ADR | Procedural lines (origin/main) | Target | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0012 | `:34-36` bootstrap teardown caution; `:105-108` two-step apply + seven secrets | existing `infra/runbooks/provision-restore.md` §"Provision from scratch" (`:88-113`) | add the teardown caution to step 1; replace ADR `:105-108` with `See infra/runbooks/provision-restore.md §"Provision from scratch".` |
| 0048 | `:30-33` import mechanics, `:51-54` state-rm + `RE-HOMED-TO-REBAR.md` marker, `:68-70` operator follow-ups | existing `infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md`, new section `## Re-homing mechanics (from ADR 0048)` placed before `## Secrets` (`:66`) | move; ADR keeps decision clauses 1–6 as one sentence each + pointer |
| 0079 | `:61-65` Back-out incl. "units ship DISABLED; enable after a manual dry-run" | existing `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` §"Continuous auto-deploy" Back-out paragraph (`:470-475`) | add the ship-disabled/dry-run sentence there; ADR `## Back-out` body → pointer. Amendments (`:74-128`) stay (rationale). |
| 0085 | `:58-71` eventual-consistency discipline, `:73-79` report procedure | NEW `infra/runbooks/reconciler-live-matrix.md` (how to run `scripts/run_live_matrix.py`, `pytest -m live`, env vars, report paths, index-lag rules, leak log) | move; ADR keeps §1–§2 + pointer. Also fix `scripts/run_live_matrix.py:2` docstring "ADR 0037 §4" → "ADR 0085 (archived into ADR 0119 §20); runbook infra/runbooks/reconciler-live-matrix.md". |
| 0031 | `:158-168` Operator break-glass (clear a wedged `refs/reconciler/lock`) | existing `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` §"The reconciler cursor" (`:159`) | move the two commands; ADR keeps pointer (the only procedure inside the consolidation set) |
| 0105 | `:94-97` "A one-time operator cutover is required… Until that runs…" | existing `infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md` §REMEDIATE (`:83`) already holds the procedure | replace the bullet with `The one-time cutover ran — task gnarly-sinistrous-groundhog (097b-de23-bf12-4c38); procedure and scrub: infra/runbooks/ssm-secret-write-only.md §REMEDIATE.` |
| 0109 | `:112-123` tier-selection table (already single-sourced at `docs/plan-review-gate.md` §"Validating a gate change: which replay tier"), `:125-139` cost table | NEW `infra/runbooks/plan-review-eval-ops.md` §"Replay tiers: invocation and budget" (`python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay tier0|tier1|tier2 …`, cost table, cap/ledger) | move cost table; replace §6 table with pointer to the gate doc; keep §6's "required, not advisory" sentence and the `plan-review-eval:` trailer convention |
| 0113 | `:85-93` change-triggered execution (`eval-changed-rubrics` job, `.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml:54`), `:95-109` heal-loop schedule + `unreliable-criterion:` ticket handling | same NEW `infra/runbooks/plan-review-eval-ops.md` §"Heal loop and the unreliable-criterion breaker" (`rebar criteria heal [--dry-run]`, ledger `.rebar/fixture_heal_ledger.jsonl`, how a human resolves a breaker ticket) | move the operating steps; ADR keeps decisions 6–7 as rules + pointer |
| 0112 | `:241-252` Open items (all resolved: S1–S6 children of epic `6202-e1c7-c57f-4897` closed; cap procedures at `review-bot-ops.md:783,909,1028,1141`, `gate-scratch-mount.md`) | existing runbooks (no new text) | replace `## Open items` with `## Open items — resolved` naming the closing story per item and the runbook sections; keep Decisions 1–7 verbatim (cited by number from `infra/scripts/*.sh`, `docs/config.md:678,697`) |
| 0059 | `:613-633` §8 Bedrock model-id trap set; `:666-693` §10 compose line anchors and the "read d2ce before quoting" status | existing `infra/runbooks/bedrock-access.md` §"Which model id to use" (`:133`) gets the trap list; `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md` §"Kill-switch: revert the LLM path" (`:281`) gets the current-wiring paragraph | move; ADR keeps one-sentence findings + pointers. Write "the removed `REBAR_LLM_MODEL`" in the runbook (`tests/unit/test_llm_model_env_removal.py:115-150` scans `review-bot-ops.md` for removal context). §9 and "Evidence-hygiene rules" stay (findings, not procedure). |

New runbooks use current vocabulary only (`bridge status`, never `bridge-status`: `test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py` does not history-exempt `infra/runbooks/`) and cite modules/CLI, never `docs/experiments/...` paths (eval-harness epic moves them).

## Scope
Edit ADRs: `docs/adr/0012-iac-foundations.md`, `0031-reconciler-ref-lock.md`, `0048-rehome-snap-shared-infra.md`, `0059-llm-provider-seam-and-support-tiers.md`, `0079-autodeploy-on-box-timer.md`, `0085-reconciler-live-validation-harness.md`, `0105-ssm-secrets-never-in-terraform-state.md`, `0109-plan-review-replay-harness.md`, `0112-on-box-disk-ceiling-architecture.md`, `0113-fixture-mining-and-admission-protocol.md`. Edit runbooks: `infra/runbooks/provision-restore.md`, `sso-auth-host.md`, `review-bot-ops.md`, `ssm-secret-write-only.md`, `bedrock-access.md`. New: `infra/runbooks/reconciler-live-matrix.md`, `infra/runbooks/plan-review-eval-ops.md`. Also `scripts/run_live_matrix.py` (docstring).

## Testing
`python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` (runbook links resolve); `python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py`; `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check`; `python scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`; `pytest tests/unit/test_llm_model_env_removal.py::test_no_prose_doc_advertises_the_variable_as_live tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_docs.py tests/unit/test_det_floor_clarity.py`; `ruff check scripts/run_live_matrix.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] For each of the nine listed ADRs, `grep -c 'infra/runbooks/' docs/adr/<file>` ≥ 1 and the moved line ranges above no longer appear (`git diff -U0` shows them removed).
- [ ] The two new runbooks exist and every `](…)` in them resolves (`check_docs_index.py --check` exit 0).
- [ ] `grep -n 'ADR 0037' scripts/run_live_matrix.py` is empty; `grep -n 'Open items$' docs/adr/0112-*.md` is empty.
